faqs.q: Will anything be published without my approval?
faqs.a: No. By default every post waits for approval, and sensitive sales messages (discounts, pricing, refunds, legal) always need your OK. You can adjust this under Settings → Approval rules.

faqs.q: Where do the analytics numbers come from?
faqs.a: Only from the platforms you connect, through their official APIs. If an account isn't connected, we show a connect prompt instead of estimates.

faqs.q: How does the AI know about my business?
faqs.a: From your onboarding answers, your website and anything you add to the Company Brain. It retrieves only your own company's knowledge before answering.

faqs.q: How do I get leads from my website?
faqs.a: Go to Settings → Website forms, copy the embed code and paste it on your site. Every submission becomes a lead that the Sales Agent qualifies.
Yes. Settings → Billing shows this month's usage and lets you set a monthly allowance, a warning level and a hard stop.

admin.noSecrets: Tokens and credentials are encrypted and never shown here.
admin.noIncidents: No incidents. Everything is running smoothly.

providers.intro: Provider configuration read from environment variables. Values are masked; secrets are never stored in the database or shown in full. Change them in your deployment's environment and restart.
providers.footer: Customers never see this page or any of these variable names.

notes.local: Local disk storage — fine for one server; use S3/R2 when running several instances.
notes.meta_secret_is_access_token: META_APP_SECRET contains an access token (starts with EAA), not the App Secret. Use App settings → Basic → App secret (32 hex characters) of the same app as META_APP_ID. If that token was shared anywhere, revoke it.
notes.meta_secret_format: META_APP_SECRET doesn't look like an App Secret (32 hex characters from App settings → Basic).
notes.meta_app_id_format: META_APP_ID must be the numeric App ID.
notes.instagram_secret_is_access_token: INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET contains an access token, not the Instagram App Secret. Use Instagram → API setup with Instagram login → Instagram app secret.
notes.instagram_secret_format: INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET doesn't look like an App Secret (32 hex characters).
notes.instagram_app_id_format: INSTAGRAM_APP_ID must be the numeric Instagram app ID (not the Facebook App ID field name).
notes.stripe_pending_keys: Stripe adapter is built; payments stay off until STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and the price ids are set.

tests.intro: Runs against the connections in your own workspace only. Testing is read-only; publishing a test post is a separate step that needs explicit confirmation.

tests.connectLink: Connect one in Settings → Connected accounts
tests.igNeedsMedia: Instagram needs an image — test publishing via Facebook
tests.confirmBody: This publishes the text above to the real account. Type {word} to confirm.

oauth.title: OAuth diagnostics
oauth.intro: Redirect URIs and permission names are not secrets. Requested = what NOVA asks for; granted = what the last sign-in in your workspace actually allowed.
oauth.redirectUri: Redirect URI (must match the developer console exactly)
oauth.noAttempt: No attempt from your workspace yet.

credential.secret_is_access_token: Code exchange will fail ("Error validating client secret"): META_APP_SECRET holds an access token, not the App Secret. Replace it with App settings → Basic → App secret.
credential.secret_format: META_APP_SECRET doesn't look like an App Secret (32 hex characters).
credential.app_id_format: META_APP_ID must be the numeric App ID.

openai.note: Tests use the real API and cost a little. The test image is stored privately in your workspace and is never attached to a post or published.
openai.costNote: actual_usage = priced from the token usage OpenAI returned; estimated = fallback estimate when usage was missing or incomplete (not the provider's actual cost). Prices come from configuration.

readiness.title: Provider readiness
readiness.intro: What is configured, what the provider actually accepted, and what has been tested live. YES only appears after a real call succeeded and was recorded.

notes.local_storage: Local disk — not a production storage test

readiness.footnote: Credential checks never publish, never connect customer accounts and don't cost money. Live product tests (test post, image generation) are separate buttons below.
readiness.waBody: Link a Cloud API phone_number_id to your current workspace. It's verified with Meta first.
readiness.callbacksIntro: Every URL to register with providers for staging and production, derived from APP_URL and the *_REDIRECT_URI settings. See docs/STAGING.md.
readiness.liveIntro: Real calls to real providers, triggered only by you. Each result is recorded above. Nothing here runs in automated tests.

health.sentryOn: Errors are also sent to Sentry.
health.sentryOff: Sentry is not configured (set SENTRY_DSN). Errors go to structured logs.

callbacks.warning: {count, plural, one {# URL is} other {# URLs are}} not public HTTPS. Providers reject localhost/http callbacks outside development — set APP_URL to the staging HTTPS origin.
